title: What is spatial privacy?
summary: Protecting sensor data and inferred profiles about people, places and behaviour over time.
body: Spatial privacy concerns both raw sensor data and the persistent profiles inferred from environments: where people are, how they move, their routines, relationships and sensitive locations. World models can create privacy risk even when those attributes were never explicitly labelled.
